rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: VNSH is an ephemeral, host-blind file sharing tool designed for AI agents and CLI workflows. It provides client-side AES-256 encryption where decryption keys remain exclusively in URL fragments, never transmitted to the server. Files automatically vaporize after 24 hours (configurable 1-168 hours). Supports sharing logs, diffs, images, and code directly from the terminal, with MCP integration enabling Claude and compatible AI agents to read encrypted content directly.
